import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula, money=True):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            v = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return
        if not np.isfinite(v):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(v, 2) if money else round(v, 1),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    num_cols = ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
                "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]
    for c in num_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    # ---- Totals ----
    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw and lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (tw - lw) / lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100", money=False)
    if ly and ly != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (tw - ly) / ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100", money=False)
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_LW)")
    ut, ul = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if ul:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (ut - ul) / ul * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100", money=False)
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    ot, ol = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if ol:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", (ot - ol) / ol * 100,
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100", money=False)

    # ---- Largest entities by this week's revenue ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for the entity")
        if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", r["Share_Pct"],
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100", money=False)
    if not top.empty:
        lead = top.iloc[0]
        add(lead["Entity"], "rank", "TW", lead["Rank"] if pd.notna(lead.get("Rank")) else 1,
            "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)", money=False)
        add(lead["Entity"], "units", "TW", lead["Units_TW"], "Units_TW for the top entity")
        add(lead["Entity"], "orders", "TW", lead["Orders_TW"], "Orders_TW for the top entity")

    # ---- Biggest WoW movers (absolute revenue change) ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    if not d.empty:
        up = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", up["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest gain)")
        dn = d.sort_values("abs_wow").iloc[0]
        if dn["Entity"] != up["Entity"]:
            add(dn["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", dn["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest drop)")

    # ---- Biggest WoW percent movers ----
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    if not p.empty:
        b = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", b["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (best)", money=False)
        w = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").iloc[0]
        if w["Entity"] != b["Entity"]:
            add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", w["WoW_Pct"],
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (worst)", money=False)

    # ---- Biggest YoY percent movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    if not y.empty:
        b = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", b["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (best)", money=False)
        w = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct").iloc[0]
        if w["Entity"] != b["Entity"]:
            add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", w["YoY_Pct"],
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (worst)", money=False)

    # ---- YoY absolute movers ----
    dy = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    if not dy.empty:
        dy["abs_yoy"] = dy["Revenue_TW"] - dy["Revenue_LY"]
        m = dy.reindex(dy["abs_yoy"].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).iloc[0]
        add(m["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", m["abs_yoy"],
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY (largest absolute swing)")

    # ---- Concentration: top 3 share ----
    if tw:
        top3 = top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum()
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top3 / tw * 100,
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100", money=False)

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
